Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

school — a place where children learn. Example: My sister works at a school.
university — a place to study after school. Example: I study at a university.
college — a place to study after school. Example: My brother studies at a college.
lesson — a period of teaching. Example: I have a lesson at nine.
subject — an area of study, like history. Example: My favourite subject is history.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• I study at ...
• My favourite subject is ...
• What is your favourite subject?
• I have a lesson at nine.
• It is interesting.
